title: Payment Arrangements Calendar Note — Weekend-Due Extension of the Pre-Suspension Grace
content:
Saturday and Sunday due dates lengthen the pre-suspension grace of the examined installment on a suspended plan under Payment Arrangements; the weekend-due extension follows the weekday of that installment's scheduled due date.

## Rule

- A due date on a Saturday adds 2 days.
- A due date on a Sunday adds 1 day.
- A due date on a weekday (Monday to Friday) adds 0 days.

The due date is the examined installment's scheduled due date as carried on its payment entries on the plan's installment history.

## Weekday table

| Weekday of the scheduled due date | Extension |
|---|---|
| Monday | 0 days |
| Tuesday | 0 days |
| Wednesday | 0 days |
| Thursday | 0 days |
| Friday | 0 days |
| Saturday | 2 days |
| Sunday | 1 day |

## Hypothetical readings

- An installment scheduled for a Saturday: its grace runs 2 days longer.
- An installment scheduled for the Sunday after: 1 day longer.
- An installment scheduled for the following Monday: no extension.
